auth.v1.PolicyAction.description:
PolicyAction is a high-level permission that can be granted by a policy.
 Product actions apply to sub-account and API-key policies, and their
 write-style actions also grant the matching read visibility where needed by
 the product experience. Account permissions, each documented below as an
 account permission or a main-account permission, apply to API-key policies
 only: a sub-account policy refuses them. Each account permission grants
 exactly the calls it names and never implies another permission. A
 main-account permission is honored only for an API key scoped to the main
 account; a key scoped to a sub-account is refused even when its policy
 grants it. An API key without a policy has no permission at all.
auth.v1.PolicyAction.title: PolicyAction

removed.description:
True when the caller no longer has access to this sub-account, for
 example after its owner removed the caller as a member: remove the
 sub-account from the caller's list. Only real-time updates set it;
 responses list only sub-accounts the caller can access. A change of the
 caller's role or access does not change revision or updated_at, so
 real-time updates deliver such changes in order and each one applies as
 it arrives. Ending access also ends the caller's subscriptions to this
 sub-account's real-time channels, and can, rarely, also end a
 subscription made after access was granted again. When the server ends a
 subscription to one of this sub-account's channels while the latest
 update lists this sub-account with a role and removed false, subscribe
 again: access is checked again on subscribe.
removed.title: removed

polyester.type.v1.U128.description:
U128 represents an unsigned 128-bit integer as two fixed64 parts:
 value = (hi << 64) | lo.

 Public amount fields that use U128, including ledger balances and fields
 named amount_e18, use fixed 18-decimal scale unless their field comment says
 otherwise. U128 can also carry raw identifiers, such as a withdraw nonce; do
 not apply decimal scaling to those fields.
polyester.type.v1.U128.title: U128
